statement: Under partial participation, mean_absent_client_old_task_accuracy is lower when each client protects its own accumulated gradient subspace than when every client uses one shared accumulated gradient subspace, with the same split, batches, participation, cap, and float64 compact polar step. This is an unverified diagnostic hypothesis. It is not a new method, and novelty is not established.
not_a_method: The three arms are measurement conditions. No new optimizer, backfill, or constraint is proposed.
voided_evidence: MLP numbers previously copied from discriminate.json, including worst-client old accuracy 0.065/0.056 and 0.033/0.054, are void. That file is marked needs_rerun because its aggregator was sequential. Those numbers are not evidence for or against H-absent.
basis_definition: At the end of each task, each client contributes the top-right singular vectors of its own gradient on a fixed prefix of its training examples, weighted by that prefix length. Vectors from every completed task are kept. The protected basis is the top basis_rank_cap eigenvectors of the sum of w V V^T. It is not an activation basis, and a new task does not overwrite earlier tasks. The shared basis pools every client's factors in that sum. QR of a concatenation is not used.
aggregation: One synchronous update from the round-start snapshot. X <- ((N-S)/N) X + (1/N) sum_{i in S} X_i, and C <- C + (1/N) sum_{i in S} (C_i_new - C_i_old). N is the client count and S is the participant count.
normalization: GroupNorm, so client batch-normalization statistics are not the measured mechanism
evaluation: For each round, absent clients are those not in the participant list. Old tasks are every task before the current one. Each absent client is scored by argmax over all logits on the pool of that client's own test-partition examples from those old tasks. Clients with no such examples are omitted. The round value is the unweighted mean of the scored clients.
test_partition: Official CIFAR-100 test examples are partitioned across clients by an independent Dirichlet draw, seed offset 8100, and saved with class counts and index hashes. This is not the global test set masked by labels.
contrast: shared minus client_specific of the seed-level mean of mean_absent_client_old_task_accuracy, paired by seed
reject_if: The 95% bootstrap interval of the mean paired difference of mean_absent_client_old_task_accuracy across seeds covers 0 or lies at or below 0.
ns_role: Not the training step. One unnormalized Newton-Schulz step has spectral norm about 1.199, which does not satisfy ||D||_2 <= 1. The arms use the compact polar and divide by max(sigma, 1).
